# SmartOne

> SmartOne makes fiscally-certified Android payment devices for European small businesses: a card payment terminal, a certified fiscal cash register and a receipt printer in one box, with a Merchant Portal included. Live in Malta; Spain (Verifactu-ready) and Slovakia in scope.

Key facts:
- One certified device replaces a separate cash register, receipt printer and card terminal — and the contracts that come with them.
- Transparent pricing: one rate per monthly-volume band, every fee shown up front. No setup fees, no inactivity fees, no settlement fees, no monthly minimums.
- Payouts go to the merchant's own existing bank account (licensed European banking partner), next business day (T+1).
- The Merchant Portal shows net amounts and the commission actually paid, in euros, for every settlement.
- Activation in four business days or less, including fiscal registration of the device.
